'''Clone Master''' was the title of [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] and [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] technologists and scientists, such as [[Tef Shabiak]] for [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] or [[Sayn Ta]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. However, the name became associated with a group of renegade [[Cloning|cloners]] who attempted a coup against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with their custom-bred [[Anti-trooper]] clones.

==History==
Kamino was kept under the watchful eye of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in order to ensure that the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] cloning technology remained under Imperial control.

A small group of [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]], resentful of the Empire's presence, began to grow an army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to use in order to fight against their perceived oppressors. These rogue clone troopers were called [[Anti-trooper|clone anti-Imperial troopers]] because they were created to fight against the Empire. They wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and were mostly [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Jet Troopers]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando heavy gunner|Rail ARC Commandos]].

The uprising was put down in the [[Kamino uprising]]. The conflict pitted these Kamino-grown troops against their own genetic brothers serving the Empire: members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], led by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had great knowledge of the facility.

The Kaminoan clones were exterminated, with Kamino remaining under Imperial control and the rogue cloning facilities being commandeered for the Empire. The leaders of the Clone Masters attempted to escape but failed. The survivors were put under Imperial rule and carefully watched by the Empire, to prevent any chances or hopes of another uprising from occurring in future.

Although the clone rebellion was soundly defeated, this incident convinced Emperor Palpatine to commission the creation of new clones from different templates and the recruitment of non-clone [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to fill the ranks of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Timothy Zahn]], in his [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''Thrawn Trilogy'']], cast the Clone Masters as the opponent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as several authors of the '90s considered that the cloners and their clones were the "villains."

However, after [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] revealed the clones were on the Republic's side, the Clone Masters were [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into being renegades who did not attack until after the formation of the Empire.
